title: Indirect questions
note: ROUGH STUB 2026-09-01. Do you know where the station is? Statement order after know / tell me. No backshift. Not if/whether as the whole unit. B1 pack stays. Sort correct / needs repair. Use = correct.

items.en: Do you know where the station is?
Do you know where is the station?
I don't know what time it is.
I don't know what time is it.
Can you tell me how much this is?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kolik to stojí?

items.en: Can you tell me how much is this?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kolik to stojí?

items.en: Do you know where the station is?
accepts: Do you know where the station is?
items.wrong: Do you know where is the station?
items.explanation: After **know**: **where the station is** — statement order. Not *where is*.
items.explanation_cz: Po **know**: **where the station is**. Ne *where is*.

items.en: I don't know where he lives.
accepts: I don't know where he lives.
I do not know where he lives.
items.wrong: I don't know where does he live.

items.en: Can you tell me what time it is?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kolik je hodin?
items.gap: Can you tell me what time ____?
accepts: Can you tell me what time it is?
items.wrong: Can you tell me what time is it?

items.en: Do you know how much this costs?
accepts: Do you know how much this costs?
items.wrong: Do you know how much does this cost?

items.en: She asked where the toilet is.
accepts: She asked where the toilet is.
items.wrong: She asked where is the toilet.
items.explanation: Keep **is** (no backshift). Order: **where the toilet is**.

items.en: I don't know when the shop opens.
accepts: I don't know when the shop opens.
I do not know when the shop opens.
items.wrong: I don't know when does the shop open.

items.en: Do you know if she is at home?
accepts: Do you know if she is at home?
items.wrong: Do you know if is she at home?
items.explanation: After **if**: **she is at home**. Not *is she*.
items.explanation_cz: Po **if**: **she is at home**. Ne *is she*.

cards.title: Indirect questions
points: A normal question: **Where is the station?**
After **Do you know** / **I don't know**, the inside is a statement.
**where the station is** — not *where is the station*.

rows: Do you know where the station **is**?
I don't know what time it **is**.

cards.title: Not Czech order
points: Czech keeps question order inside: *kde je nádraží*. English does not.

rows: *Do you know where is the station?*
Do you know where the station **is**?
*I don't know what time is it.*
I don't know what time it **is**.
